Rashi on Pesachim 57b:1:1.english: He signaled with his hand - In a mocking tone.

Rashi on Pesachim 57b:1:2.hebrew: אימתא דמלכותא - לא דיו שלא אמר כמותי, אלא שאמר אף בלשון צחוק:
Rashi on Pesachim 57b:1:2.english: Reverence for the monarchy - Not only did he not speak like me, but he even spoke in a mocking tone.

Rashi on Pesachim 57b:1:3.english: Who caused him to bear - Who caused [him] to bear his iniquity and his recompense.

Rashi on Pesachim 57b:2:1.english: Did not study - [He] did not study Mishnah or Baraita.

Rashi on Pesachim 57b:2:2.hebrew: כבשים קודמין לעזים - בכ"מ כתב כבש תחלה:
Rashi on Pesachim 57b:2:2.english: Lambs take precedence over goats - In every place [Scripture] wrote "lamb" first.

Rashi on Pesachim 57b:2:3.hebrew: אם כבש יביא לחטאת - כאן הקדים שעירה לכבשה, דכתיב בפרשה עליונה "והביא את קרבנו שעירת עזים" וגו', והדר "אם כבש יביא" וגו':
Rashi on Pesachim 57b:2:3.english: If he brings a lamb for a sin offering - Here [Scripture] placed the female goat before the female lamb, as it is written in the preceding section: "And he shall bring his offering, a female goat," etc., and afterward: "If he brings a lamb," etc.

Rashi on Pesachim 57b:2:4.hebrew: אם כבש אם עז - גבי שלמים, מדלא הראה לך הכתוב רמז מובחר בזה מזה, שמעת מינה ששניהן שוין:
Rashi on Pesachim 57b:2:4.english: If a lamb, if a goat - Regarding peace offerings: since Scripture did not show you an indication of superiority in one over the other, you learn from this that both are equal.
